users.title: Users
users.description: Who can sign in to Maane, and what they may do.
users.protectedHint: Made at setup; it stays an admin and cannot be disabled.
users.createHint: The user signs in with this username and password, then sets up two-factor authentication.

roleHint.admin: Manages users, settings, and the audit log.

users.endSessionsMessage: They are signed out everywhere and can sign in again.

settings.title: Settings

defaultLocale.label: Default language
defaultLocale.hint: The language of the sign-in page and of every browser that has not chosen its own.

sessionDays.label: Session length (days)
sessionDays.hint: A user who does not open Maane for this long signs in again. {min} to {max} days.

env.tooltip: An environment variable sets this value; change it there.

explain.listening: Listening: Maane records each message and what it would have done, and opens no ticket. Use it until cutover.
explain.live: Live: each message opens a ticket or joins one. It needs a default address.

settings.graphIntro: Maane reads the intake mailbox through Microsoft Graph, read only. It never moves, marks, or deletes mail.

graphTenant.label: Tenant
graphTenant.hint: The Entra tenant's ID, or one of its domain names, like {example}.

graphClient.label: Application (client) ID
graphClient.hint: The ID of the Entra application that may read the intake mailbox.

graphSecret.label: Client secret
graphSecret.hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Type a new secret to replace it; leave the field empty to keep it.
graphSecret.replace: Type a new secret to replace it

graphMailbox.label: Intake mailbox
graphMailbox.hint: The shared mailbox the transport rules copy mail to, like {example}. Another mailbox starts a new intake source; what Maane already took in stays.

test.label: Connection
test.hint: Reads only the Inbox folder details of the saved mailbox. A pass does not show that the permission is limited to this mailbox: check that in Exchange as the deployment notes describe.
test.saveFirst: Save the Graph settings first: the test uses the saved ones.
test.notTestedNote: Save the settings, then test the connection.
test.okToast: Maane can read the intake mailbox.
test.noAnswer: The test did not finish. Check that the worker is running, then try again.

problem.not_configured: A tenant, application, secret, or mailbox is missing.
problem.credential: Entra refused the tenant, the application, or the secret.
problem.access_denied: Graph refused access to this mailbox.
problem.not_found: Graph did not find this mailbox.
problem.throttled: Graph asked Maane to slow down. Try again in a minute.
problem.network: Graph did not answer. Check the server's network.

settings.filesIntro: Maane scans every file with ClamAV before it keeps it. An infected file or a blocked type is never stored.

scanner.label: Scanner
scanner.hint: Maane trusts a clean result only from a scanner that passed its self-test: the scanner must find the EICAR test file and alert on an encrypted ZIP and an encrypted PDF. The worker runs it at start, every hour, and when the address changes.
scanner.notCheckedNote: The worker has not tested a scanner yet. Check that the worker is running.
scanner.loadFailed: Could not read the scanner's status.

check.eicar: The scanner did not find the EICAR test file
check.encrypted_zip: No alert on an encrypted ZIP
check.encrypted_pdf: No alert on an encrypted PDF

scanner.saveFirst: Save the new address first: the test checks the saved one.
scanner.testNoAnswer: The test did not finish. Check that the worker is running, then try again.

scannerAddress.label: Scanner address
scannerAddress.hint: The clamd Maane scans with, as {form}. The bundled scanner is {bundled}. An outside clamd needs {alerts} set to yes, and {stream} at least as large as the largest file.

explain.block: Block: incoming files wait and are scanned when the scanner answers again.
explain.allow: Allow: incoming files are stored marked not scanned, and never shown as clean.

maxBytes.label: Largest file (MB)
maxBytes.hint: Maane does not scan or keep a larger file. {min} to {max} MB.

blockedTypes.label: Blocked file types
blockedTypes.hint: File name extensions and types read from the content, separated by commas or lines. A blocked file is handled like an infected one. It applies to the file itself, not to the files inside an archive.

scanTimeout.label: Scan time limit (seconds)
scanTimeout.hint: How long one file scan may take before Maane stops waiting and the setting below decides. {min} to {max} seconds.

sending.intro: Maane sends replies through SMTP2GO first, always with TLS. Nothing else changes at SMTP2GO.
sending.failoverIntro: When SMTP2GO certainly did not take a reply, Maane tries this server, always with TLS.

port.label: Port
port.hint: Ports 465, 8465, and 443 use TLS from the start; every other port uses STARTTLS, required.

user.label: SMTP user
user.hint: The SMTP user made at SMTP2GO for Maane.

password.label: SMTP password
password.hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. To replace it, type a new one; an empty field keeps it.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.hint: Only for reading delivery status (SMTP2GO's activity search). Stored encrypted and never shown again.

webhookPath.label: Delivery webhook
webhookPath.hint: The address SMTP2GO reports delivery status to. Its last part is secret: give it to SMTP2GO only, under Settings, Webhooks.

webhookToken.label: Authorization header
webhookToken.hint: At SMTP2GO, choose the Bearer authorization type and paste this token. Requests without it are refused.

host.label: SMTP server
host.hint: Leave empty when there is no backup server.

port.label: Port
port.hint: The port of the backup server.

security.label: Encryption
security.hint: STARTTLS, required, or TLS from the start. Plain SMTP is never used.

user.label: SMTP user
user.hint: Leave empty when the server needs no sign-in.

password.label: SMTP password
password.hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. To replace it, type a new one; an empty field keeps it.

bounceAddress.label: Bounce address
bounceAddress.hint: The envelope sender of mail sent through the backup server, for example bounces@{example}. It must reach the intake mailbox.

test.hint: Connects with TLS and signs in with the saved settings. It sends nothing.
test.okToast: Maane can sign in to the mail server.
test.saveFirst: Save this server's settings first: the test uses the saved settings.

problem.not_configured: The server, the user, or the password is missing.
problem.connection: The server did not answer. Check the server name, the port, and the network.
problem.tls: TLS could not be set up. Check the port and the encryption.
problem.auth: The server refused the user or the password.
problem.error: The server answered with an error.

webhook.notSetNote: Make the address and the token, then copy both into SMTP2GO.
webhook.setNote: Maane keeps them encrypted and does not show them again. Make new ones to replace them.
webhook.replaceTitle: Replace the webhook's address and token?
webhook.replaceMessage: The current ones stop working at once. SMTP2GO's delivery reports are refused until you give it the new ones.
webhook.shownOnce: Copy both now: Maane shows them only this once.
webhook.done: A new webhook address and token were made.

organizations.name: Name

check.none: No address or pattern matches, and there is no default address. Intake flags such a message for review.

organization.deleteMessage: The organization is removed for good.

addresses.defaultHint: Mail whose support address cannot be identified comes here.
addresses.removeMessage: New mail to it no longer reaches this organization. Tickets that already came in keep it.

members.removeMessage: They stop seeing this organization's tickets at once.
members.allMembers: Every agent found is already in this organization.

signature.title: Signature
signature.emptyHint: Replies of this organization end without one.

mail.header: Reply to this email to update the conversation.

compose.noFrom: This organization has no support address to send from. Add one on its page.

uploadHint.scanner_unavailable: The scanner did not answer, and the settings block unscanned files. Try again later.

compose.empty: Write a message or attach a file first.
compose.toRequired: Add at least one recipient in To.

delivery.marked: marked as sent by an agent
delivery.unknownTitle: Maane does not know whether this reply went out.

delivery.refusedAll: The mail servers refused every recipient.

problem.listening: Intake is listening, so Maane sent nothing.

problem.unreachable: Maane could not reach or sign in to any mail server, so nothing was sent.

delivery.resendDone: The reply is on its way again.
